question: Which V2O5 film thicknesses were tested electrochemically, how many ALD cycles gave the thicker film, and did the potential shifts differ between them?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%cycle%' OR text ILIKE '%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%thick%' OR text ILIKE '%mV%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, kind, text FROM atoms WHERE kind='sentence' AND (text ILIKE '%electrochem%' OR text ILIKE '%potential%' OR text ILIKE '%shift%') ORDER BY page
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (4,5) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (1,2) AND (text ILIKE '%ALD%' OR text ILIKE '%40%' OR text ILIKE '%nm%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page>=6 ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (2,3) ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT figure_id, line_no, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%cycle%' OR text ILIKE '%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%mV%' OR text ILIKE '%thick%' OR text ILIKE '%40%' OR text ILIKE '%80%' ORDER BY figure_id, line_no

SELECT id, figure_id, statement, value, unit, condition FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%cycle%' OR statement ILIKE '%nm%' OR statement ILIKE '%thick%' OR statement ILIKE '%shift%' OR statement ILIKE '%mV%'
SELECT id, page, text, atoms FROM sentences WHERE text ILIKE '%80 nm%' OR text ILIKE '%40 nm%' OR text ILIKE '%1000 ALD%' OR text ILIKE '%similar shifts%' OR text ILIKE '%1500%' ORDER BY page
SELECT id, text, value, unit, role, about, quantity FROM measures WHERE text IN ('1000','40','80','∼40','∼80','40 mV','∼40 mV','1500','500') OR (page=4) ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, figure_id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%500%' OR text ILIKE '%1000%' OR text ILIKE '%40 nm%' OR text ILIKE '%80%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%nm%'

rendered: The electrochemically tested V2O5 films came in a thicker film of about ∼80 nm[1] and a thinner film of about ∼40 nm[2]. The thicker film was made with 1000 ALD cycles[3]. The thickness series in Fig. 1[4] labels the thinner film with 500[5] ALD cycles. Potential shifts did not differ in size: the text reports potential shifts of ∼40 mV[6] and states that similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) were observed[7] for both films. The shift data for the thinner film are in the Supporting Information, and the strain dependence for the thicker film is shown in Fig. 4[8].
